reason: A chat UI visual enhancement that renders a configurable Matrix-style code-rain background, optionally driven by the current conversation's reasoning text, with persisted display settings.

summaries.zh: 为聊天界面添加可配置的黑客帝国代码雨背景，并可选择使用当前会话的思考链作为雨中文字内容。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable Matrix-style code-rain background to the chat interface, optionally using the current conversation's reasoning text as rain content.

capabilities: Modifies the chat interface with a canvas-based matrix rain overlay
Reads reasoning text from the current conversation to drive displayed rain characters
Provides user-configurable visual settings with host-side persistence
Includes an optional runtime patch to expose the plugin settings namespace
